c74object.name: evi_paf
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A basic 'paf' formant oscillator, very similar to the legacy 'paf~' external
c74object.description:
evi_paf is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_paf.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_trig.genexpr
evi_paf is also available in MSP as: evi.paf~.
'PAF' (phase aligned formant) is an oscillator that can model the human voice. Typically multiple PAF oscillators make up a formant model, as in evi.formantosc~. However single evi.paf~ instances can provide novel oscillators for more generic synthesis. The formant is controlled by frequency (inlet 2) and bandwidth (inlet 3). In this model the PAF is approximated by adding two 'wavepackets' together, which are also available separately on auxilliary outputs. The PAF algorithm is inherently bandlimited.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ fundamental, cf, bw, reset } }

geninlet.name: fundamental
geninlet.digest: Frequency in Hz. The fundamental frequency of the oscillator in Hz.

geninlet.name: cf
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min 0 @max 18000 @default 440.. The frequency of the formant above the fundamental.

geninlet.name: bw
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min 0 @max 18000 @default 110.. The bandwidth in Hz of the formant above the fundamental.

geninlet.name: reset
geninlet.digest: Phase (do not use). Naive reset of the oscillator phase.
